documents.title: Engineering Department Travel and Technical Offsite Policy (2026)
documents.summary: Covers engineering travel guidelines, technical hackathons and offsite summits across Bengaluru, Hyderabad, and Pune, daily meal allowance (₹2,500/day), hotel allowance up to ₹6,500/night in Tier-1 cities, Uber/Ola for Business corporate profiles, and Vande Bharat rail travel.

documents.title: Cortex Engineering Policy Directive: Engineering Department Travel and Technical Offsite Policy (2026)
documents.summary: Rich formatted Word document detailing engineering travel rules, ₹2,500/day per diem, hotel ceilings up to ₹6,500/night in metropolitan hubs, Uber and Ola corporate integration, and travel approval procedures.

documents.title: Engineering Workstation, Hardware Provisioning, and Cloud Sandbox Infrastructure Policy
documents.summary: Mandates hardware provisioning allowances for engineers up to ₹1,50,000 (MacBook Pro M3 or Lenovo ThinkPad P-Series), 3-year refresh cycles with buyback options, monthly cloud sandbox/homelab stipend (₹5,000/month), and endpoint security (AES-256, CrowdStrike Falcon).

documents.title: Engineering Infrastructure Security Directive: Production Secret Vault, Zero-Trust Access, and Incident Notification
documents.summary: Confidential infrastructure security directive detailing dynamic secrets management with HashiCorp Vault (24-hour TTL), mandatory database password rotation every 60 days with shadow swapping, statutory CERT-In cybersecurity incident notification within 6 hours (Directions 2022 under IT Act Section 70B), 180-day log retention, and SSH bastion access restricted to Bengaluru office static IPs.

documents.title: Global Corporate Finance Policy: Business Travel, Expense Reimbursement, and GST Invoicing Compliance
documents.summary: Corporate finance travel rules mandating bookings strictly via MakeMyTrip Corporate portal, domestic daily meal allowance cap of ₹1,500/day, hotel accommodation cap of ₹4,500/night, strict statutory rule requiring valid GST invoices with company GSTIN for any reimbursement exceeding ₹500, and 15-day claim submission deadlines.

documents.title: Finance Confidential Directive: Statutory External Audit Protocols, Tax Provisioning, and Transfer Pricing Governance
documents.summary: Confidential finance directive governing mandatory advance tax payment quarterly schedules under Section 211 of the Income Tax Act (15th June 15%, 15th Sept 45%, 15th Dec 75%, 15th March 100%), interest under Section 234B/234C, Transfer Pricing documentation and Form 3CEB under Section 92E, statutory external audit by Big 4 auditors with 5-year partner rotation (Companies Act 2013 Section 139), and CapEx DoA approval limits in INR.

documents.title: Human Resources Policy: Talent Relocation, Transfer Support, and Domestic Travel Guidelines
documents.summary: Governs talent relocation grants, transfer packages, and HR assignment travel. Details daily meal allowance (₹1,800/day), inter-city relocation lump sum assistance of ₹75,000 for transfers to Bengaluru, Gurugram, Hyderabad, or Mumbai, 14 days complimentary company guest house stay, empaneled packing/moving coverage up to ₹50,000, and 12-month retention service agreement.

documents.title: Human Resources Policy: Leave Entitlements, Statutory Benefits, and Remote Work Framework (2026)
documents.summary: Establishes leave entitlements (24 days annual leave, 12 days casual/sick leave), 26 weeks paid maternity leave under Maternity Benefit (Amendment) Act 2017, 10 days paternity leave, Core Working Hours (10:00 AM - 4:00 PM IST), one-time home office setup reimbursement of ₹35,000, monthly broadband reimbursement of ₹1,500/month, and EPF/Gratuity statutory compliance.

documents.title: Cortex Human Resources Policy: Leave Entitlements, Statutory Benefits, and Remote Work Framework (2026)
documents.summary: Rich formatted Word document covering annual leave (24 days), casual/sick leave (12 days), 26 weeks maternity benefit, ₹35,000 home office setup allowance, ₹1,500/month broadband subsidy, and statutory retirement social security.

documents.title: Confidential Governance Protocol: Prevention of Sexual Harassment (POSH Act 2013), Code of Conduct, and Whistleblower Protection
documents.summary: Confidential HR and legal compliance directive covering mandatory constitution of the Internal Complaints Committee (ICC) under the POSH Act 2013 (Presiding Officer senior woman, 50% female representation, external NGO/legal member), strict 90-day inquiry completion SLA, 10-day report submission, Section 16 confidentiality rules (₹5,000 statutory penalty), interim relief measures, disciplinary actions, and whistleblower anti-retaliation shield.

documents.title: Engineering SOP: Deployment, Canary Release, and Automated Rollback Procedures
documents.summary: Defines the production deployment SOP including 4-stage canary release (5%, 25%, 50%, 100% traffic splits), automated rollback triggers (>0.5% HTTP 5xx errors for 2 consecutive minutes, p99 latency >800ms), Helm rollback commands, database migration backward-compatibility via Expand/Contract pattern, and mandatory RCA requirements (full RCA within 24 hours, post-mortem within 3 business days).

documents.title: Confidential SOW: Project Apex — Tier-1 Banking Client Integration Architecture
documents.summary: Confidential Statement of Work for Project Apex — integration of Cortex Enterprise RAG Platform with a Tier-1 banking client. Covers AWS VPC peering, Apache Kafka at 15,000 TPS, mTLS, 99.99% uptime SLA, p95 latency <120ms, RPO <1 minute, RTO <15 minutes, milestone billing schedule, and RACI matrix.

documents.title: Finance Policy: Vendor Procurement, Capital Expenditure Approval, and Competitive Bidding Framework
documents.summary: Establishes vendor procurement, CapEx approval, and competitive bidding framework. Mandatory 3-quote rule for purchases above ₹2,00,000, formal RFP for >₹10,00,000. DoA matrix: Manager up to ₹5,00,000, VP up to ₹25,00,000, CFO above. GSTIN verification mandatory before payment, Net 30-45 payment terms.

documents.title: Human Resources Policy: Annual Performance Appraisal, 360-Degree Review, and Variable Pay Cadence
documents.summary: Annual performance cycle: H1 mid-year (July) and H2 year-end review (December/January). 5-point rating scale, bell-curve distribution (5% Outstanding, 15% Exceeds, 60% Meets, 15% NI, 5% UA). 360-degree feedback, 60-day PIP. Variable pay multiplier: 1.5x Outstanding, 1.2x Exceeds, 1.0x Meets, 0.0x NI/UA. Disbursed with March payroll.

documents.title: Security Governance Manual: SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and Quarterly Access Review Procedures
documents.summary: Confidential security governance manual covering SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001:2022 compliance. Quarterly IAM access recertification every 90 days. Credential rotation: passwords 60 days, SSH keys 90 days. FIDO2/WebAuthn mandatory for privileged access. Incident severity: SEV-1 (>20% users, 15-min response), SEV-2 (1-hour), SEV-3 (4-hour). DR drills quarterly; RPO <1 min, RTO <15 min.

documents.title: Legal & Compliance Framework: India Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act 2023
documents.summary: Cortex's compliance framework under India DPDP Act 2023. Data Principal rights (access, correct, erase, withdraw consent), data retention schedule (payroll 8 years, HR files 7 years, candidate data 6 months), mandatory DPBI breach notification within 72 hours, DPO responsibilities, SDF readiness, cross-border transfer restrictions.
